subject: Post-demo: Buying timeline, owner map, and evidence request
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@clearsighthealth.com>, Marcus Ellison <marcus.ellison@clearsighthealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed owners & evidence list

Thanks again for carving out time today — enjoyed the demo conversation. As promised, a concise recap, owners we recommend for next checkpoints, and an initial evidence request list your procurement/security teams typically ask for.

Key recap (2 min):
- Goal: Replace batch embedding pipeline and add low-latency QA features into ClearSight’s clinician portal (approx. 30k queries/day peak).
- Success criteria: <15% query latency improvement at 95th pctl for interactive queries; embeddings parity within 1% on current semantic-similarity evals; <10% monthly cost delta vs current infra target.

Proposed owners (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Marcus Ellison (we heard budget is owned by Marcus’ org)
- Security approver: Claire Park (infosec lead)
- Procurement lead: procurement@clearsighthealth.com (we’ll need payment & contract routing)
- Product/PO: Dr. Lina Gomez (you mentioned she’ll sign off on clinical requirements)

Immediate next steps (my suggested sequence):
1) You: Confirm owners and add procurement contact to thread (by EOD Tue)
2) Naomi: Share MAP draft (attached) and evidence list for InfoSec — target Wed
3) ClearSight: Return prioritized decision criteria (latency/cost/accuracy ranked) and any hard blockers (e.g., on-prem requirement) — target next Tue

Attachments included: map_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP skeleton with milestones), security_q_asklist.pdf (starter evidence packs), redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (initial sizing + estimate).

Ask: Can you confirm the procurement email and whether you need an executed W-9 or PO template up front?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

----
(Attachment: map_draft_v1.xlsx)
(Attachment: security_q_asklist.pdf)
(Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx)

From: Claire Park <claire.park@clearsighthealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Ellison <marcus.ellison@clearsighthealth.com>, procurement@clearsighthealth.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed owners & evidence list

Thanks Naomi — good recap and the attachments look useful. Confirming owners: Marcus is the economic buyer and will own budget decisions; I’ll shepherd security questions but will loop in our InfoSec analyst (Anil Shah) as needed. Procurement (procurement@clearsighthealth.com) is correct.

Quick answers:
- We prefer to review evidence in this order: SOC2 report, data residency docs, data retention and deletion flow, and encryption-at-rest details.
- We will not require an on-prem deployment for initial POC; want to keep it hosted in us-west for latency testing.
- W-9 not necessary for the POC, but procurement will expect a PO + SOW for a Dedicated evaluation.

Marcus and I are available Thu 03/31 10:00–11:00 PT and Fri 04/01 14:00–15:00 PT for an internal alignment call. If Naomi is available we can also include Jordan (SE) for a technical run-through.

Claire
Head of Security & Compliance
ClearSight Health
claire.park@clearsighthealth.com

----

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed owners & evidence list

Appreciate the quick confirmation, Claire — that ordering is perfect. I updated the MAP with the owners you confirmed and added a short procurement checklist (see map_draft_v1.xlsx v1.1).

Couple of updates and asks:
- Proposed cadence: MAP milestones with owners and dates — POC kickoff (week of 4/11), security evidence exchange (by 4/15), POC validation (2 weeks after kickoff), procurement/contract review (target sign by 5/15). Please push back if those windows are unrealistic.
- Evidence we’ll provide this week: SOC 2 Type II summary, architecture diagram with encryption notes, data retention & deletion playbook, sample audit logs.
- Procurement asks from your side: is there any vendor onboarding paperwork or a vendor security questionnaire we should fill out directly (e.g., OneTrust vendor form)? If so, please point us to the link.

Jordan — can you prepare a short tech-brief (1 pager + test plan) for the Thu internal alignment call? Rishi — can you confirm a 30% uplift scenario pricing and one Dedicated evaluation SOW stub we can share?

Claire / Marcus — I’ll tentatively schedule Thu 03/31 10:00–11:00 PT and will move if you prefer Fri slot.

Thanks,
Naomi

Naomi — noted. Drafted the Dedicated evaluation SOW stub and a 30% uplift pricing scenario. I attached two quick stubs to the thread and dropped comments where we should be conservative (network egress, monitoring retention).

Jordan — I left a TODO for the test plan to include:
- 95th pctl latency tests for interactive queries (baseline vs Redwood POC)
- Embedding similarity parity check with your sample eval dataset
- Tokenization/edge-case QA (PHI redaction check)

I’ll attach redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (v2) with more granular line items; Naomi, please share that directly with procurement and Claire.

Rishi Malhotra
